result:
Round 156 passes. I found no bugs, and every browser row ran in real Chromium at 1440×900 and 1280×720, so `browserVerified` = `realVerified` = true.

| Row | Result |
|---|---|
| T156-TARGETED | PASS: I re-ran A's 34 test files and got 576/576, the same as A. The new tests (ST-TP1–3, TH11, WSU3–5, the extended CSU1) are all green. |
| SOURCE-SCOPE | PASS: HEAD is `4c07d5f`. The working tree has exactly the 10 granted modified files and the 2 new files. The 963 frozen files and A's 12 end hashes match. The protected files are unchanged, and my hashes of all 975 files were identical at the start and end of my phase. |
| AN-REVIEW | PASS: I read the diff myself. Every change is inside the task rows, and every new span uses exactly `font-mono font-normal tabular-nums`. No existing test line was removed. Doc 125 changed only its status line; doc 126 is in Georgian and follows the template. |
| TEXT-BYTES (a)–(f) | PASS in 3 valid sessions: the visible text is byte-identical to the expected strings, including the em and en dashes. The selected-clip line also equals its `title` attribute. |
| MONO-STYLE N7–N12 | PASS: every timecode span renders IBM Plex Mono at weight 400 with tabular numbers, and the browser reports the regular face, not Medium. The text around them keeps its old font and weight (Instrument Sans 500 where the container is medium, 400 in the footer). The video-gap time still updates during playback. |
| LAYOUT-FIT | PASS: nothing new is cut off or wraps. Mono adds 6 to 24 px per site, and every label stays on one line and fully visible. |
| PLEX500-INVENTORY-S | PASS: no element uses Plex Mono at weight 500 or above in any state I checked, and that font file is never loaded. The only text at weight 600 is the Export dialog title, as expected. |
| FUNC-SMOKE-S | PASS: playback produces real audio output (peak 0.1266). Range Delete, cross-lane move, library drop and lane mute all work, and Ctrl+Z restores each. |
| G156-3 | PASS: a fresh session with no credentials opens the demo page. The premium page `/studio/middle-east` shows "Sign in required" with no workspace and no audio, and `/api/studio-token` returns 401. The fake-Bearer 403 check is BLOCKED because the backend isn't available in the cloud. |
| PX-NET / REG-HYD | PASS: no forbidden requests, no auth headers, no hydration messages and no page errors in any valid session. |

Two runs didn't count:
- **Cold first load:** the first 1440 session hit the known cold-Vite error ("Invalid hook call" and a hydration replace). I used the one allowed replacement.
- **My script mistake:** in the second 1440 session, my script dragged a clip onto an occupied lane. The app correctly refused the move and made no Undo entry, but my script pressed Ctrl+Z anyway and undid an earlier add. I fixed the script and re-ran both viewports. The app behaved correctly throughout.

Notes for B (none of these is a finding):
- The task says to make range (a) with a ruler drag, but in this build a ruler drag scrolls and zooms the view and never makes a selection. I used a clip-body drag from 3 s to 5 s instead (the same gesture CSU1 uses). Future tasks should say "clip-body or lane drag".
- After Ctrl+Z of a range Delete, the clips come back but the time selection isn't shown again. That code didn't change this round, and I haven't checked how Live behaves.
- The all-tracks range label and the drop-ghost label sit on top of the clip's title. That overlap existed before this round; mono makes the labels only 6–8 px wider.
- A's T1 inserted one import line into `strings.test.ts` instead of a pure append; no existing line changed.
- Doc 126 never uses the label "R6", but it covers that item under B-R155-EXPORT-ZERO.

Ableton parity doesn't apply: mono timecodes are a CZABA brand decision from `visual-direction-a.md`. The full test suite, typecheck, build, Biome, verify and the e2e smoke test are left to the root gate.

Everything is in `tmp/studio-real-loop/`; start with `c-round-156.md`. The scripts, raw output and screenshots are in `c-round-156/`.
